messages.subject: problems with statements that attempt to match (==, %in%)
parts:
This statement
dt.FBS.kcals.fish <- dt.FBS.kcals[IMPACT_code %in% IMPACTfish] (which is FBSManipulation.R#33)

works fine when I run it in the console, when I run the whole script, or when I source the .R file.

But when I run  devtools::document()

I get the error message

    Error in match(x, table, nomatch = 0L) (from FBSManipulation.R#33) : object 'IMPACT_code' not found 

But IMPACT_code is in fact in the data table dt.FBS.kcals as a character vector
str(dt.FBS.kcals$IMPACT_code)
 chr [1:160212] "c_FrshD" "cbana" "cbarl" "cbeef" "cbeef" "cbeef" "cbeer" "cbutr" "cbutr"

and IMPACTfish is also a character vector
str(IMPACTfish)
 chr [1:10] "c_shrimp" "c_Crust" "c_Mllsc" "c_Salmon" "c_FrshD" "c_Tuna" "c_OPelag" "c_ODmrsl" ...

Do I need to do something different to get devtool::document() to run?

Thanks
Jerry Nelson
